Package com.egradx.files

Class EgradxFileService

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.files.EgradxFileService
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.beans.factory.Aware, org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisherAware
public class EgradxFileService extends Object implements org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisherAware
Uploads, reads, lists and deletes files (docs/files/design.md). Every call names its caller — who, in which organization, with which authorities — and a file outside the caller's organization does not exist for them (404).

Who may do what: the uploader may always read and delete their own file; a profile photo is readable by anyone in its organization and deletable only by its owner; a file attached to an application record is decided by the EgradxFileAccessPolicy for its type, when there is one; otherwise the permissions egradx.file.read, .write and .delete decide.

    • upload

      public EgradxFileDto upload(EgradxFileService.Caller caller, EgradxFileService.Upload upload, String purpose, String attachedType, String attachedId)
      Stores a file in the caller's organization.
      Parameters:
      purpose - attachment when null; lower-case letters, digits, - _ .
      attachedType - the kind of application record it belongs to, with attachedId; both or neither
      Throws:
      EgradxFileException - FILE_TOO_LARGE, FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED, FILE_EMPTY, FILE_REJECTED, FILE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
